candidate_windows.window_text: In this analysis, we incorporated a diverse array of models, distinguished by their parameter sizes, which span from 7B to 70B, and their context window capacities, extending from 8K to 200K. Additionally, the evaluation encompassed models constructed on a state-space architectural framework. The models scrutinized in this investigation comprises ChatGLM3-6B-32K (Zeng et al., 2022; Du et al., 2022), Mistral-7B-Instructv0.1 (Jiang et al., 2023a), Zephyr-7B- $\beta$ (Tunstall et al., 2023), StripedHyena-Nous-7B (Poli et al., 2023), Longchat-13B-16K (Li et al., 2023a), Qwen-14B-Chat (Bai et al., 2023a), Yi-34B (AI et al., 2024), Alfred-40B-1023 (Hallström et al., 2023), StableBeluga-2-70B (Mahan et al., 2023), Tulu-2-DPO-70B (Ivison et al., 2023), ChatGPT-1106 $^{6}$ , and GPT-4-1106-preview (OpenAI et al., 2024).

All experiments in this evaluation were conducted on a server with $4^{*}$ A100 80GB GPUs. We set the batch size to 1. For models with a scale of 7B and 13B, we use one GPU; for models around 30B, we use two GPUs; and for models at the 70B scale, we use four GPUs.
